text: The safety controller shall clamp any commanded insulin dose it receives to no more than [max dose rate -- TBD] before forwarding it to the pump, independent of whether the dosing algorithm's computed value is correct.
The safety controller shall reject (fail-safe: block the dose, do not pass it through) any dose command received via a corrupted, malformed, or unrecognized message on the main-controller interface.

The device shall treat the CGM signal as lost if no valid reading has been received within [dropout timeout -- TBD], and shall then pass no glucose value to the dosing algorithm and shall raise a signal-loss indication, rather than reuse the last known reading.
The device shall reject any glucose reading outside [plausible range min -- TBD] to [plausible range max -- TBD] and shall not pass it to the dosing algorithm.

The device shall reject any glucose reading whose change from the previous accepted reading exceeds [max physiological rate of change -- TBD] over the elapsed time, and shall not pass it to the dosing algorithm.
